description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the AbstractVertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter class, verifying MQTT protocol handling, connection management, message processing, authentication, topic subscriptions, and limit enforcement within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing MQTT protocol handling and connection management in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock services, configuration, and dependencies for testing.

methods.name: shutDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes Vertx instance.

methods.name: testStartup
methods.description: Verifies MQTT server startup and service connections.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerFailsWithoutDownstreamConnections
methods.description: Checks connection rejection when downstream services are unavailable.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerAcceptsUnauthenticatedDevices
methods.description: Verifies acceptance of connections without authentication if configured.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerRejectsDeviceOfDisabledTenant
methods.description: Ensures connection rejection for devices belonging to disabled tenants.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerRejectsUnauthenticatedDevices
methods.description: Checks rejection when devices fail authentication and auth is required.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerTriesToAuthenticateDevice
methods.description: Verifies authentication process is invoked during connection.

methods.name: testEndpointHandlerRejectsConnectionsAboveLimit
methods.description: Tests rejection of connections exceeding max allowed limits.

methods.name: testAuthenticatedMqttAdapterCreatesMessageHandlersForAuthenticatedDevices
methods.description: Ensures message handlers are created upon successful auth.

methods.name: testAuthenticatedMqttAdapterRejectsConnectionForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Verifies rejection if device credentials do not correspond to registered device.

methods.name: testUnauthenticatedMqttAdapterCreatesMessageHandlersForAllDevices
methods.description: Confirms message handlers for devices without authentication.

methods.name: testHandlePublishedMessageFailsForMalformedTopic
methods.description: Checks that malformed topics result in message discard.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageFailsForEmptyTopic
methods.description: Ensures messages with empty topic are discarded.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageFailsForUnknownDevice
methods.description: Verifies rejection if device registration cannot be asserted.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Checks rejection of messages for tenants marked as disabled.

methods.name: testUploadEventMessageSendsPubAckOnSuccess
methods.description: Verifies PUBACK is sent after successful event forward.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageSendsPubAckOnSuccess
methods.description: Verifies PUBACK is sent after telemetry message is accepted downstream.

methods.name: testUploadQoS1MessageSendsPubAckOnSuccess
methods.description: Checks proper PUBACK after QoS 1 message is accepted.

methods.name: testOnUnauthenticatedMessageDoesNotSendPubAckOnFailure
methods.description: Ensures no PUBACK on failed message acceptance.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryMessageIncludesRetainAnnotation
methods.description: Verifies retain flag is included in downstream message annotation.

methods.name: testOnSubscribeWithQos0RegistersAndClosesConnection
methods.description: Verifies commands with QoS 0 are registered and connection closed properly.

methods.name: testOnSubscribeWithQos1RegistersAndClosesConnection
methods.description: Verifies command registration for QoS 1 and proper connection handling.

methods.name: testOnSubscribeIncludesStatusCodeForEachFilter
methods.description: Checks SUBACK contains correct status codes for various filter subscriptions.

methods.name: verifyEventMessageUsesTtlValueGivenInPropertyBag
methods.description: Verifies TTL from property bag is used in downstream messages.

methods.name: verifyEventMessageLimitsTtlToMaxValue
methods.description: Verifies TTL is capped by tenant maximum.
